title: vulpia teneriffae
intro: Vulpia teneriffae, commonly known as Canary Island hair grass, is a species of grass native to the Canary Islands. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which are attributed to its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant effects, contributing to its use in the treatment of various health conditions. The health benefits of Vulpia teneriffae include its potential to reduce cardiovascular risk, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects are thought to be flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and cardioprotective properties.
